The difference-in-differences estimate is about 6.52 Reais per customer.

Group means from the data:

| | May (pre) | July (post) | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Porto Alegre (treated) | 46.02 | 87.06 | +41.05 |
| Florianópolis (control) | 171.64 | 206.17 | +34.52 |

The DiD estimate is 41.05 − 34.52 = 6.52. The interaction coefficient `poa:jul` from an OLS regression of deposits on `poa`, `jul` and their interaction gives the same value, 6.5246 (standard error 5.73, so not statistically significant).

ANSWER: 6.52
